en: The GR_VA_Analyzer is a natural language processing web service that performs automatic detection and classification of specific types of verbal attacks expressed in Greek Twitter against specific targets. The current version of the service is designed to address verbal attacks against specific groups of targets with regard to the following two domains: Xenophobia, including ten predefined target groups of interest (migrants, refugees, ethnic minorities). Politics, including political leaders and parties in Greece and politicians of these parties. You can use this service to process raw Twitter data (Tweet text), in UTF-8 encoded TXT format and obtain the output in either UTF-8 encoded GateXML format or in CSV file format. The GR_VA_Analyzer is developed and maintained by ILSP/ATHENA RC. It constitutes the last step of a workflow consisting of the following processing steps: sentence splitting, tokenization, lemmatization, part of speech tagging and verbal aggression detection and classification. Therefore, the output of the service includes annotations on the level of sentence ( Sentence ID , Sentence ), token ( Token ID , Token , Token Start , Token End ), lemma , part of speech according to ILSP_NLP PoS Tagset , and verbal aggression types and targets (VA Target Evidence, VA Target Start, VA Target End, VA Target ID and VA Type according to Greek Verbal Aggression Tagset and VA Evidence). See the Output Annotation Schema field below for more information on the respective tagsets. Detailed information about the targets and types of verbal attacks available can also be found in GR_VA_Analyzer_Annotation_Types . For technical reasons, the file submitted for processing may be split into smaller files, and so will the output. This service is seamlessly integrated into the CLARIN:EL infrastructure's workflows, providing users with convenient and easy access as a web service. You can use this service by clicking the " Use " button on this page or by accessing it through the CLARIN:EL processing services page .
